column3: The provisions of this Act shall apply where–
any act which constitutes an offence under this Act
takes place in Sri Lanka irrespective of whether the
person who commits such offence is in Sri Lanka or
a  person  commits  an  offence  under  this  Act  in
Sri Lanka, while in Sri Lanka; or
an offence under this Act, wherever committed, is
committed by a person who is a citizen of Sri Lanka.
